genes <- read.delim(gzfile('subtype.inflammation.q1.genes.txt.gz'), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

m1 <- readMM(gzfile('subtype.inflammation.q1.1.mtx.gz'))
m2 <- readMM(gzfile('subtype.inflammation.q1.2.mtx.gz'))
cat(dim(m1), dim(m2), '\\n')
cat('nonzeros', nnzero(m1), nnzero(m2), '\\n')
# basic stats

cat('gene sums nonzero counts:\\n')
gs1 <- Matrix::rowSums(m1); gs2 <- Matrix::rowSums(m2)

# top genes by total counts
top <- head(sort(gs1+gs2, decreasing=TRUE), 20)

EOF
